name: sky-lockup
title: Sky Lockup
description: Logo outro in under two seconds. A one-line promise takes itself apart word by word, the white page washes off to a soft sky, and the mark in the middle of the sentence slides over, turns white and picks up your wordmark. Measured frame by frame off a reference recording.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/sky-lockup?ref=cli — 57 frames at 30fps; paints its own background. Pass your logo as SVG paths (logo={{ width, height, shapes }}). — 82 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
